lines.en: label makotowinterbeach4:
scene wintersky
Morning comes before any of us want it to.
lines.zh: 早晨在我们任何人想要它之前就来了。

lines.en: But I suppose that’s just how vacations always end.
lines.zh: 不过我想，假期总是这么结束的。

lines.en: Even if those vacations happen to last no longer than a day.
lines.zh: 哪怕那些假期碰巧只持续了一天。

lines.en: We pack our things and head for the bus stop.
lines.zh: 我们收拾好东西，往公交站走。

lines.en: It arrives roughly seven minutes later.
lines.zh: 大约七分钟后车来了。

lines.en: Makoto sits next to me once we board.
lines.zh: 上车后 Makoto 坐在我旁边。

lines.en: Miku sits in the row across from us despite how our current bench could easily fit three people.
lines.zh: Miku 坐在我们对面那排，尽管我们这张长椅坐三个人绰绰有余。

lines.en: She doesn’t say much all morning.
lines.zh: 她一早上都没怎么说话。

lines.en: Neither does Makoto, but Makoto’s silence seems to be on account of being tired and not impulsively dry humping her teacher to climax last night.
lines.zh: Makoto 也没怎么说话，但她沉默似乎是因为累了，而不是因为昨晚冲动地干蹭她的老师直到高潮。

lines.en: The bus drives slightly over the speed limit, making the clouds work mildly harder to keep up with us.
lines.zh: 大巴开得略微超速，逼得云朵得更卖力一点才能跟上我们。

lines.en: On the way home, I notice the mangled corpse of a tanuki decaying along the side of the road.
lines.zh: 回家路上，我注意到路边有一具被碾烂的狸猫尸体正在腐烂。

lines.en: No one else notices it.
lines.zh: 没有别人注意到它。

lines.en: And if they do, they elect to remain silent instead of pointing out the beautiful yet grotesque concept of life spawning from death.
lines.zh: 就算注意到了，他们也选择保持沉默，而不是指出「生命自死亡中诞生」这个美丽又怪诞的概念。

lines.en: I focus on the yellowish mound of wriggling larvae on top of the corpse, trying desperately to live and not become the breakfast of a touring bird.
lines.zh: 我盯着尸体上方那堆扭动的黄色蛆虫，它们拼命想活下去，不想成为某只巡游鸟儿的早餐。

lines.en: As the bus moves further away, I spot a buzzard.
lines.zh: 大巴越开越远，我看见了一只秃鹫。

lines.en: I accept that death comes for everyone and everything.
lines.zh: 我接受死亡会降临到每个人、每件事身上。

lines.en: scene black
And then I close my eyes to the sensation of a glove-covered hand landing on one of my thighs.
lines.zh: 然后我闭上眼睛，感受着一只戴着手套的手落在我的一条大腿上。

lines.en: Not sexually, but to provide comfort.
lines.zh: 不是出于性，而是为了安慰。

lines.en: Or to attempt to provide comfort.
lines.zh: 或者说是试图提供安慰。

lines.en: Or to attempt to be sexual but provide comfort instead.
lines.zh: 或者说是试图带点性意味，结果反倒成了安慰。

lines.en: Essentially, there is a hand on my thigh.
lines.zh: 总而言之，有只手在我的大腿上。

lines.en: I don’t know what it means.
lines.zh: 我不知道这意味着什么。

lines.en: I don’t know what anything means.
lines.zh: 我不知道任何事意味着什么。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome1
Miku winds up getting off the bus several stops before Makoto and me.
lines.zh: Miku 最后比我和 Makoto 早几站下了车。

lines.en: I expected Makoto to get off as well, but it appears that one night alone was not enough to clear her mind of the things she’d locked away in it.
lines.zh: 我原以为 Makoto 也会下车，但看来仅仅一夜还不足以清空她脑子里锁着的那些东西。

lines.en: She requires, at the very least, one more morning in order to do that.
lines.zh: 要做到那一点，她至少还需要一个上午。

lines.en: And with Ami at work and not able to run interference between the two of us, it makes complete sense to invite her over and see what happens next.
lines.zh: 而 Ami 在上班，没法在我们俩之间打岔，那邀请她来我家、看看接下来会发生什么就完全说得通了。

lines.en: I doubt it will be anything exciting.
lines.zh: 我怀疑不会有什么刺激的事。

lines.en: And, on the off chance it is, I don’t even have any condoms.
lines.zh: 而且万一真有，我连避孕套都没有。

lines.en: Today is already off to a bad start.
lines.zh: 今天开局就不顺。

lines.en: But I suppose it’s time to see how much worse it is going to get.
lines.zh: 不过我想，是时候看看它还能糟到什么程度了。

lines.en: : I obviously can’t speak for you, but {i}I{/i} had a good time yesterday.
lines.zh: : 我显然不能代表你说话，但{i}我{/i}昨天过得很开心。

lines.en: : And you managed to make it through the entire night without [molesting] me, so I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t a little impressed.
lines.zh: : 而且你居然撑了一整晚没有[molesting]我，所以我要说不吃惊那就是在撒谎。

lines.en: : {s}I made your best friend cum.{/s} Yeah, I’m impressed with myself as well.
lines.zh: : {s}我让你最好的朋友高潮了。{/s}是啊，我也挺佩服自己的。

lines.en: : Do I get a reward?
lines.zh: : 我有奖励吗？

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome2
: Do you want one?
lines.zh: : 你想要吗？

lines.en: : Obviously. When do I ever {i}not{/i} want one?
lines.zh: : 当然。我什么时候{i}不要{/i}过？

lines.en: : Then...how about I tell you a secret?
lines.zh: : 那么……我告诉你一个秘密怎么样？

lines.en: : Why do I feel like this secret isn’t going to be the type of reward I’m looking for?
lines.zh: : 为什么我感觉这个秘密不是我想要的那种奖励？

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome3
: Because despite our obvious progress, I still feel a shadow lurking somewhere in the background.
lines.zh: : 因为尽管我们明显有进展，我依然感觉到有个影子潜伏在背景里的某个地方。

lines.en: : And I’m afraid that as soon as I go back to my dorm, the shadow will fuse with you and turn you back into the same guy who gets off on picking on me.
lines.zh: : 而我担心，我一回宿舍，那个影子就会跟你融合，把你变回那个以捉弄我为乐的家伙。

lines.en: : It’s my shadow. It’s already fused with me.
lines.zh: : 那是我的影子。它已经跟我融合了。

lines.en: : I suppose that’s true. But sometimes, when the light is angled just perfectly, it moves really far away.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧。但有时候，当光线角度刚好对的时候，它会跑得很远。

lines.en: : And, forgive my inadequacy when it comes to poetry, but I would very much like to be that light this morning.
lines.zh: : 而且，请原谅我在诗意上的笨拙，但今天早上我非常想成为那道光。

lines.en: : Is everything okay? You’re acting a little...unusual right now.
lines.zh: : 一切都好吗？你现在表现得有点……不寻常。

lines.en: : Is that genuine concern or do you just feel obligated to say that?
lines.zh: : 这是真心的关心，还是你只是觉得该这么说？

lines.en: : A little of both.
lines.zh: : 两者都有点。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Everything is okay.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。

lines.en: : Good. Because-
lines.zh: : 很好。因为——

lines.en: : But only because I force everything to be okay.
lines.zh: : 但只是因为我强迫一切都变好。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Is this where the secret comes into play?
lines.zh: : 秘密是不是就在这儿登场了？

lines.en: : This is where the secret comes into play.
lines.zh: : 秘密就是在这儿登场。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome4
Makoto takes a deep breath and closes her eyes for a moment.
lines.zh: Makoto 深吸一口气，闭上眼睛片刻。

lines.en: If this were a normal morning, she’d be breathing in the scent of french toast or an omelette made with an ungodly amount of meat in it.
lines.zh: 如果这是个平常的早晨，她闻到的该是法式吐司的香味，或者一份塞了惊人数量的肉的煎蛋卷的香味。

lines.en: But, as I walked out on the girl who would normally make those things in favor of spending time with Makoto yesterday, there is no scent at all.
lines.zh: 但因为昨天我抛下那个平时会做这些的女孩，选择去陪 Makoto，所以现在一点香味都没有。

lines.en: She breathes in plain air.
lines.zh: 她吸进去的只是平淡的空气。

lines.en: It fills her lungs and I watch as her chest expands and contracts.
lines.zh: 它填满她的肺，我看着她的胸膛一起一伏。

lines.en: She remains silent for a moment before confessing something to me.
lines.zh: 她沉默了片刻，然后向我坦白了某件事。

lines.en: : I’ve been having some pretty strange dreams lately, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我最近做了一些挺奇怪的梦，老师。

lines.en: : They come out of nowhere. Sometimes, when I’m not even sleeping.
lines.zh: : 它们来得毫无预兆。有时候，我甚至没在睡觉的时候也会出现。

lines.en: I've heard this before.
lines.zh: 我以前听过这个。

lines.en: : I very rarely make it out of those dreams.
lines.zh: : 我很少能从那些梦里走出来。

lines.en: : They’re always the kind that end with you on the brink of death. When the moment death comes is the moment that wakes you.
lines.zh: : 它们总是那种以你濒临死亡收尾的梦。死亡降临的那一刻，就是把你惊醒的那一刻。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome5
: You know the kind of dreams I’m talking about, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我说的那种梦吧？

lines.en: : Of course. That phenomenon of waking up just as you’re about to die in a dream isn’t exactly uncommon.
lines.zh: : 当然。在梦里快要死掉的那一刻醒来，这种现象并不罕见。

lines.en: : I know. It’s a direct result of the combination of REM sleep with the flood of adrenaline that comes from being inserted into a stressful or terrifying situation.
lines.zh: : 我知道。这是快速眼动睡眠与被扔进一个充满压力或恐怖的处境时涌出的肾上腺素相结合的直接结果。

lines.en: : But a more interesting phenomenon is when every single journey through REM sleep yields the same exact dream.
lines.zh: : 但更有趣的现象是，当每一次快速眼动睡眠之旅都产生完全相同的一个梦。

lines.en: : It turns something so obviously fake into something that feels just as real as waking up and starting your morning routine.
lines.zh: : 它把某种明显虚假的东西，变得跟醒来开始早晨例程一样真实。

lines.en: : For me, that routine is brewing a pot of coffee, taking a shower, straightening out my uniform, and then texting my mother to say good morning.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，那个例程是煮一壶咖啡、洗个澡、把校服整理好，然后给我妈发短信说早安。

lines.en: : But lately, that routine has started to become weighed down by the excruciatingly dark undertones of myself and a blanket of stars not at all dissimilar from what we saw on the beach last night.
lines.zh: : 但最近，这个例程开始被压得喘不过气——被我自己那极其阴郁的底色，还有一层和我们昨晚在海边看到的没什么两样的星幕压着。

lines.en: : Well, yes. The night sky is dark by nature. I wouldn’t exactly say that’s a dark undertone, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。夜空本来就是暗的。不过我还真不会说那是阴郁的底色。

lines.en: : By itself, no. But when you start having the same dream over and over and over again, you start having time to analyze different aspects of it.
lines.zh: : 单看它，不算。但当你开始一遍又一遍做同一个梦，你就开始有时间去分析它的不同面向。

lines.en: : The dream is not just of the sky itself but of me as I swim through it.
lines.zh: : 那个梦不只是关于天空本身，还有在天空里游动的我。

lines.en: : The only issue is, you can’t swim through the sky. And so logic dictates that I would have to be falling.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，你没法在天空里游。所以按逻辑推论，我只能是在坠落。

lines.en: : Or flying, since it’s a dream and logic doesn’t influence dreams.
lines.zh: : 或者在飞，毕竟那是梦，而逻辑影响不了梦。

lines.en: : To say it doesn’t influence them is a bit of a reach, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 说逻辑完全影响不了梦，是不是有点牵强？

lines.en: : Pretty much everything we see is tied to logic in one way or another. Things very rarely happen without reason.
lines.zh: : 我们看到的几乎一切都以某种方式和逻辑相连。很少有事情是毫无理由发生的。

lines.en: : And so, as someone who spends far too much time bathing in this aspect of human thought, it’s easy for me to understand what’s happening in those dreams of mine.
lines.zh: : 所以，作为一个花了太多时间泡在人类思维这个面向里的人，我很容易就明白我那些梦里在发生什么。

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 是什么？

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome6
: I’m jumping, idiot.
lines.zh: : 我在跳，笨蛋。

lines.en: : I’m having recurring dreams about jumping off of something, somewhere.
lines.zh: : 我在反复做同一个梦，梦见从某个地方、某个东西上跳下去。

lines.en: : And I believe that the reason for this is that there has been something dark growing inside of me for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 而我相信，这是因为有某种黑暗的东西在我体内生长了很久很久。

lines.en: : My own shadow, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我自己的影子吧，我想。

lines.en: : Just mine compels me to think about things like jumping out of a moving car on the highway or taking a few extra painkillers just to see what would happen.
lines.zh: : 只不过我的影子会逼我去想一些事，比如在高速公路上从行驶的车里跳出去，或者多吃几片止痛药，就为了看看会怎样。

lines.en: : That...definitely sounds a little worse than what my apparent shadow makes me do.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来确实比我那个影子让我干的事糟一点。

lines.en: : Worse, sure. But I’m stronger than you and would never let something like that overtake me the same way you let {i}yours{/i} overtake {i}you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 是更糟。但我比你强，绝不会让那种东西像你被{i}你的{/i}影子压倒那样压倒我。

lines.en: : No matter how many times I have that dream, I’ll never try to reenact it.
lines.zh: : 不管那个梦做多少次，我都绝不会试着把它变成现实。

lines.en: : I’m smart. I have a bright future ahead of me. I have a wonderful best friend. And I like to think I’m at least decently attractive.
lines.zh: : 我很聪明。我前程光明。我有一个很棒的最好的朋友。而且我愿意认为自己至少还算挺有魅力。

lines.en: : You’re very attractive, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你非常有魅力，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome7
: You’re only saying that because it’s directly linked to the possibility of us having more sex in the future.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为它直接关系到我们将来能不能多做几次爱。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. But also because it’s true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。但也因为这是真的。

lines.en: : But why spend time thinking about all of those things when, comparatively, your situation isn’t all that bad?
lines.zh: : 不过相比之下，你的处境又没那么糟，为什么还要花时间想那些事？

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome8
: I’ve explained something like that to you in the past, haven’t I?
lines.zh: : 我以前跟你解释过类似的事吧？

lines.en: : What was my reasoning back then?
lines.zh: : 我当时是怎么说的来着？

lines.en: : I think it was something like “That's just the way it is.”
lines.zh: : 我记得大概是「事情本来就是这样」之类的话。

lines.en: : Then that’s my reasoning this time, too.
lines.zh: : 那这次我的理由也一样。

lines.en: : Not everyone has complete control over their emotions the way you do, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都能像你那样完全掌控自己的情绪，老师。

lines.en: : There are some people out there who would laugh in the face of all that I go through if it happened to them.
lines.zh: : 有些人如果经历我所经历的这些，会当面大笑。

lines.en: : But the amount of effort I put into hiding that part of me really only makes me more tired at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 但我为了藏起那部分的自己所付出的努力，到头来只会让我更累。

lines.en: : Mix that with an onslaught of dreams that feel more like memories of horrible things and you have one unhappy Makoto.
lines.zh: : 再掺进一波波更像是对可怕事情的回忆的梦，你就得到了一个不开心的 Makoto。

lines.en: : And, it might not always work, but the best medicine for an unhappy Makoto is someone who can constantly remind her that her troubles are nothing but troubles.
lines.zh: : 而且，这未必总是管用，但治疗一个不开心的 Makoto 最好的药，是有个人能不断提醒她：她的烦恼不过是烦恼而已。

lines.en: : And most troubles go away with time.
lines.zh: : 而大多数烦恼都会随时间消失。

lines.en: : Dreams, too.
lines.zh: : 梦也是。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome9
: I don’t want to die, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不想死，老师。

lines.en: : And it’s not that I don’t want to die. I don’t want to think about dying. And, at this point, it’s become almost an inevitability.
lines.zh: : 也不是说我不想死。是我不想「去想」死亡。而到了这一步，它几乎已经成了一种必然。

lines.en: : I’ll never give into something just because of an inevitability, though. So I guess that's one area where I could be considered an idiot.
lines.zh: : 不过我绝不会因为某事是必然的，就向它屈服。所以我想，在这点上我大概可以被当成个傻瓜。

lines.en: : But the fact that part of me is there at all is just...
lines.zh: : 但我的某一部分确实就在那里，这件事本身就……

lines.en: : Scary.
lines.zh: : 很吓人。

lines.en: : Not even that.
lines.zh: : 甚至不只是吓人。

lines.en: : It’s just...exhausting.
lines.zh: : 只是……让人筋疲力尽。

lines.en: : I’m so tired.
lines.zh: : 我好累。

lines.en: : Well then wake up, loser.
lines.zh: : 那就醒醒吧，输家。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome10
: Oh, would you look at that. I’m perfectly fine, now.
lines.zh: : 哦，你看看。我现在完全好了。

lines.en: : Thank you so much for listening to me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你听我说这些，老师。

lines.en: : Any time, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 随时奉陪，Makoto。

lines.en: : You know that a big part of why I say things like this to you is because I think you can handle it, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我之所以对你说这些话，很大一部分是因为我觉得你扛得住，对吧？

lines.en: : Obviously, but even I have limits.
lines.zh: : 当然，但连我也有极限。

lines.en: : And so I figured coming out and trying to properly explain more about the things I’m feeling to you would help.
lines.zh: : 所以我想，干脆把我的感受更多地好好解释给你听，应该会有帮助。

lines.en: : The issue with that is that even though I can try to explain those things, I feel like I can’t even come close to properly doing them justice.
lines.zh: : 问题在于，就算我试着解释那些事，我也觉得自己根本没法贴近它们真正的样子。

lines.en: : All of those dreams and all of those things that I see, even though I {i}know{/i} they’re dreams, still feel like more.
lines.zh: : 那些梦，还有我看到的所有那些东西，即使我{i}知道{/i}它们是梦，感觉上依然不止是梦。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome11
: I know I’ve already compared them to memories, but...even that word doesn’t really apply.
lines.zh: : 我知道我已经把它们比作回忆了，但……连那个词都不太贴切。

lines.en: : But I’m sure that this combined with everything else I’ve forced onto you over the last 24 hours doesn’t exactly allude to my expected stability, does it?
lines.zh: : 不过我敢说，这些加上过去 24 小时里我硬塞给你的其他一切，大概很难让人觉得我很稳定吧？

lines.en: : Oh, I’ve already given up on expecting stability from you.
lines.zh: : 哦，我早就放弃指望你稳定了。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome12
: Is that an insult?
lines.zh: : 那是侮辱吗？

lines.en: : More of an evaluation.
lines.zh: : 更像是个评估。

lines.en: : You have depression, right?
lines.zh: : 你有抑郁症，对吧？

lines.en: : Probably. Over 10%% of all people are expected to have some sort of mental disorder. It would make sense if that was the reason behind all of this.
lines.zh: : 大概是。据估计超过 10%% 的人都有某种精神障碍。如果这就是这一切背后的原因，也说得通。

lines.en: : That number definitely seems higher than 10%% based on all of the people I find myself associating with on a daily basis.
lines.zh: : 就我每天打交道的那些人来看，这个数字肯定比 10%% 高得多。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome13
: We really don’t have the most...stable class, do we?
lines.zh: : 我们班真的算不上……最稳定的，是吧？

lines.en: : Not even close.
lines.zh: : 差得远呢。

lines.en: : But what I’m saying is that you don’t really need to worry about how you look to me or anyone else.
lines.zh: : 但我想说的是，你真的不必担心在我或其他任何人眼里你是什么样子。

lines.en: : Like, if you ever want to show up to[school] some time and skip out on doing my work for me, just tell me.
lines.zh: : 比如说，要是哪天你去[school]不想替我做我的工作，直接告诉我就行。

lines.en: : And if I ask to just...{i}always{/i} skip out on your work?
lines.zh: : 那如果我要求……{i}永远{/i}都不做你的工作呢？

lines.en: : Well that would just be irresponsible if you want me to keep teaching.
lines.zh: : 如果你想让我继续教书，那可就太不负责任了。

lines.en: : Right...that would be completely irresponsible of {i}me...{/i}
lines.zh: : 对……那{i}我{/i}就太不负责任了……

lines.en: : There you go. Now you’re starting to get it.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。你开始懂了。

lines.en: : What I’m confused about, though, is that if you don’t expect stability from me...what do you expect?
lines.zh: : 不过我搞不懂的是，既然你不指望我稳定……那你指望我什么？

lines.en: : Because all this time I’ve been citing myself as the cool, calm, collected one.
lines.zh: : 因为一直以来我都把自己标榜为那个冷静、沉着、镇定的人。

lines.en: : I expect literally nothing from you.
lines.zh: : 我对你真的毫无期待。

lines.en: : Well that's just plain rude.
lines.zh: : 那可就太无礼了。

lines.en: : You’re a fucking [teenager], Makoto. Stop being an adult and just chill for once.
lines.zh: : 你就是个他妈的[teenager]，Makoto。别老端着大人样，偶尔放松一下吧。

lines.en: : Do you want to sit behind my desk from now on? Will that make you feel better?
lines.zh: : 要不从现在起你坐我办公桌后面？那样你会好受点吗？

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome14
: Can I?!
lines.zh: : 我可以吗？！

lines.en: : Does that...really make you that excited?
lines.zh: : 那……真的让你这么兴奋吗？

lines.en: : Forgive the pun but, depressingly so!
lines.zh: : 请原谅我玩这个谐音，但——令人沮丧的是，确实如此！

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome15
: And...since we’re already on the topic of things that would make me feel better...
lines.zh: : 还有……既然我们都在聊能让我好受点的事了……

lines.en: : Could I ask you to...maybe be a little more honest with me from now on?
lines.zh: : 我能请你……从现在起对我稍微坦诚一点吗？

lines.en: : Honest about what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体对什么事坦诚？

lines.en: : Honest about the things that I already know you’re doing but you’ve yet to come out and admit to.
lines.zh: : 对我已经知道你在做、但你还没坦白承认的那些事坦诚。

lines.en: : Oh...{i}those{/i} things.
lines.zh: : 哦……{i}那些{/i}事啊。

lines.en: : Sensei...I don’t need to know {i}who{/i} else you have a more...{i}adult{/i} relationship with, but I’d at least gain some solace in knowing that you trust me enough to not blurt it out to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 老师……我不需要知道你还跟{i}谁{/i}有比较……{i}成人{/i}的关系，但至少知道你信任我、不会把它随口说给别人听，我会得到一些安慰。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking I was doing you a service by {i}not{/i} telling you things I expect will upset you.
lines.zh: : 我还一直以为，{i}不{/i}把那些我觉得会让你难过的事告诉你，是在帮你的忙。

lines.en: : I never promised to not get upset. I just said that it would provide some solace.
lines.zh: : 我从来没答应过自己不会难过。我只是说它会给我一些安慰。

lines.en: : And wallowing in sadness is exponentially easier than wallowing in uncertainty.
lines.zh: : 而且沉溺在悲伤里，比沉溺在不确定里要容易得多。

lines.en: : Uncertainty? But I thought you “already knew?”
lines.zh: : 不确定？可你不是说你「已经知道」了吗？

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome16
: Nothing is truly certain unless you see it with your own eyes or hear it with your own ears.
lines.zh: : 除非你亲眼看见、亲耳听见，否则没有什么是真正确定的。

lines.en: : And even then, there’s the possibility of what you see or hear being an object of delusion.
lines.zh: : 即便如此，你看到或听到的东西仍有可能是妄想的产物。

lines.en: : So nothing is ever certain as a whole.
lines.zh: : 所以整体上，没有任何事是确定的。

lines.en: : But there are some things that are a lot easier to accept once they’re out in the open.
lines.zh: : 但有些事一旦摊开在明面上，就容易接受得多。

lines.en: : So...I won’t say something like “I’ll be happy with just knowing” because that would make me a liar.
lines.zh: : 所以……我不会说「只要知道就够了」这种话，因为那会让我变成骗子。

lines.en: : But I’d probably be able to fall asleep a little better.
lines.zh: : 但我大概能睡得好一点。

lines.en: : And that would be a...good start.
lines.zh: : 而那会是个……不错的开始。

lines.en: Oh, fuck it.
lines.zh: 哦，管他呢。

lines.en: Makoto’s been racking up losses left and right.
lines.zh: Makoto 一直在左一个右一个地吃败仗。

lines.en: It won’t kill me to hand her a single victory when I can’t imagine she’d be one to let anyone know about it.
lines.zh: 既然我想象不出她会是那种到处说的人，那给她一场胜利也死不了。

lines.en: After all, who would she even tell?
lines.zh: 毕竟，她又能告诉谁呢？

lines.en: : Your...suspicions are correct.
lines.zh: : 你的……猜测是对的。

lines.en: : There are others.
lines.zh: : 还有别人。

lines.en: scene makotocomeshome17
: Can I...ask you how many or would that be pushing it?
lines.zh: : 我能……问有多少个吗，还是那太得寸进尺了？

lines.en: : That would be pushing it.
lines.zh: : 那就得寸进尺了。

lines.en: : Accept your victory and move on with whatever solace that was able to provide.
lines.zh: : 收下你的胜利，带着它带来的那点安慰继续往前走吧。

lines.en: : It feels out of place to say it in this context...but thank you.
lines.zh: : 在这个语境下说这个有点不合时宜……但还是谢谢你。

lines.en: : Thank you for trusting me and thank you for not viewing me as a wicked witch.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你信任我，也谢谢你没把我当成邪恶的女巫。

lines.en: : And again, thank you for not [molesting] me in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 还有，再次谢谢你半夜没有[molesting]我。

lines.en: : I realize that was probably the hardest for you out of all of those things.
lines.zh: : 我明白，在这一切之中，那大概是你最难做到的。

lines.en: : Is there any chance for a...second reward?
lines.zh: : 有没有机会再来……第二个奖励？

lines.en: : Right now? Seriously?
lines.zh: : 现在？认真的？

lines.en: : No. Get out of here, you pervert.
lines.zh: : 不行。滚出去，你这个变态。

lines.en: : But...this is my house.
lines.zh: : 可……这是我家。

lines.en: : Fine. {i}I’ll{/i} get out, then.
lines.zh: : 行。那{i}我{/i}出去。

lines.en: scene black
: Wait. I was only kidding. You don’t have to-
lines.zh: : 等等。我只是开玩笑。你不用——

lines.en: : I do. I skipped my entire morning ritual anyway, so I have to catch up on all of that.
lines.zh: : 我要。反正我整个早晨的例程都跳过了，所以得把它们补回来。

lines.en: : I’m really happy we got to spend so much time together this weekend, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的很开心，这个周末我们能一起待这么久。

lines.en: : Because even if...I know there are other girls now-
lines.zh: : 因为就算……我现在知道还有别的女孩——

lines.en: : At least there weren’t for one night.
lines.zh: : 至少有一个晚上没有。

lines.en: Except there were.
lines.zh: 除了，其实有。
